extra.final_summary: The data had three issues: (1) Category labels had inconsistent spacing/case (e.g., ' Electronics', ' Office Supplies'); these were normalized to valid labels. (2) Two rows had negative Quantity values (-4, -5), which violate the rule that Quantity must be at least 1; these rows were excluded. (3) One row (row 1) had an incorrect Revenue value (480 vs expected 48); it was recomputed as Quantity * Price. After fixes, the analysis shows total units sold: East: 84, North: 75, South: 101, West: 79.
